t=df['t'].values; P=df['P'].values; y=df['dP_dt'].values
def nmse(pred): return np.mean((pred-y)**2)/np.var(y)
one=np.ones_like(P)
Ps=[one,P,P**2,1/P]
tfs={'t':t,'sqrt':np.sqrt(t),'log':np.log(t),'E':np.exp(t/12),'sin':np.sin(t),'cos':np.cos(t),'t2':t**2}
import itertools
names=list(tfs)
best=[]
for combo in itertools.combinations(names,2):
    cols=[p for p in Ps]
    for g in combo:
        cols+= [tfs[g]*p for p in Ps[:3]]
    A=np.vstack(cols).T
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)[0]
    best.append((nmse(A@c),combo))
best.sort()
for b in best[:6]: print('%.3e'%b[0], b[1])
